D5/S3/Quantum/Dynamics/ObserverPullbackT.signature: theorem observer_pullback_trace_identity (channel : QuantumChannel d d) (heisenberg : MatrixAlgebra d →CP MatrixAlgebra d) (hduality : ∀ state effect : MatrixAlgebra d, Matrix.trace (channel.toCompletelyPositiveMap state * effect) = Matrix.trace (state * heisenberg effect)) (t : Nat) (rho : DensityState d) (effect : MatrixAlgebra d) : Matrix.trace ((evolvedState channel t rho).1 * effect) = Matrix.trace (rho.1 * ((fun A : MatrixAlgebra d => heisenberg A)^[t]) effect)
